hook.name: StewHook
hook.description: A fee-skimming hook that takes a configurable cut (default 1%, max 3%) from swaps on registered token pools via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas, with an elevated "rush rate" (default 8%, max 20%) for early buys within a configurable block window after launch. Accrued fees are tracked per "chef" address and claimable via scoop().
